verdict.rationale: OpenCode has a documented `opencode run "..."` non-interactive CLI command for one-shot scripted execution, plus `--auto` flag to auto-approve permissions and a headless `opencode serve` mode with OpenAPI/SDK for programmatic control, all fitting scripting/automation workflows. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of non-interactive scripting reliability (e.g. CI usage reports) beyond docs.
